Aliya’s Awakening: DOGE 2042

Welcome to the world of Aliya’s Awakening: DOGE 2042, a narrative-driven interactive cyberpunk adventure game. In a world where government has become the most influential megacorporation, information and privacy are the most valuable currency. Advanced surveillance, AI security, and ruthless corporations dominate every aspect of society, controlling what people see, hear, and believe.

Meet the Protagonist: Aliya

Aliya is a cybersecurity analyst working for Cascadia, a multi-trillion dollar megacorporation, striving to secure a better future for her family. After meeting Lua, her Shiba Inu best friend, he became her world, driving her to work harder, take on more responsibilities, and ensure he had the best care possible.

One day while alone working, her office was raided. Everything she has and has worked for was taken away in an instant. Imprisoned and accused of a crime she didn't commit, Aliya must find the truth before it’s too late.

A Deeply Personal and Dynamic Story

  • Dystopian Future - Enter a world controlled by megacorporations and surveillance, where trust is a luxury.

  • Interactive Cyberpunk World - Explore sprawling cityscapes, high-security prisons, and corporate offices, uncovering corruption hidden beneath the neon lights.

  • Inspired by a True Story -  Dive into a story of friendship, loss, resilience, and the struggle for truth where the lines between truth and lies are blurred.

Unique Gameplay Mechanics

  • Zoom & Enhance - commandeer cutting-edge surveillance drones to perform unique in-game mechanics to zoom into buildings and utilize advanced AI to enhance and reconstruct crime scenes.

  • Remote Hack - Take up your own investigation. Uncover clues and mysteries as you become your own detective to prove your innocence.

Full-Featured Computers

  • Check emails, read messages, browse files, and uncover secrets. Investigate encrypted data, crack hidden codes, and make difficult decisions that will shape Aliya’s fate.

Alternate-Reality

  • Search for hidden websites, encrypted messages, and secret files that connect the game’s mystery to the real world.

  • Solve ARG challenges to unlock additional in-game content, lore, and hidden paths in the story.

A world that hides the truth is a world waiting to be hacked. Will you take control, or become just another victim of the system?
